name: taste-skill
description: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages
readme: Taste Skill (tasteskill 2.5.1) is an Agent Skill that makes coding agents build professional company websites at the figma.com and x.ai level instead of assembling a generic landing page. Every build uses plain copy, one design system, one section per screen, equal left and right edges, real photographs (licensed stand-ins when the client has none), real brand icons and real product UI, a hero entrance and one or two dealt moments on every page, quiet micro-interactions, and shader effects and scroll scenes kept strictly for tech, gaming and software pages, all verified in a real browser by a checker and a finish gate that enforce the rules.
